title: feat: Airtable-style single-row toolbar for list views
body: Redesigns the ListView toolbar to match Airtable's compact single-row toolbar pattern and removes the duplicate ObjectView toolbar. ### Changes - **ListView toolbar**: Single Airtable-style row with tool buttons (`Hide fields` | `Filter` | `Group` | `Sort` | `Color` | `Row height`) left-aligned, expandable `Search` right-aligned - **ObjectView toolbar**: Removed duplicate filter/sort/search/refresh controls (delegated to ListView). Now only renders named view tabs and create button when needed. - Compact `h-7` ghost buttons with `text-xs` labels and `3.5x3.5` icons - Search collapses to a button by default; expands inline on click with auto-focus, collapses on blur when empty - `Hide fields`, `Group`, `Color`, `Row height` rendered as disabled placeholders for future implementation - Cleaned up unused imports (`FilterUI`, `SortUI`, `Search`, `Input`, `RefreshCw`) and unused `searchQuery` state from ObjectView - Updated tests to account for expandable search interaction flow and removed search controls from ObjectView ### Affected packages - `@object-ui/plugin-list` — `ListView.tsx` - `@object-ui/plugin-view` — `ObjectView.tsx` --- 💬 We'd love your input! Share your thoughts on Copilot coding agent in our [2 minute survey](https://gh.io/copilot-coding-agent-survey).
